items.author: Musk
items.text: Musk plans $100 billion SpaceX launch site in coastal Louisiana
items.summary_cn: Musk宣布在路易斯安那州沿海投资1000亿美元建设SpaceX超级发射场，重大资本开支扩张直接利好kcn的SPCX/SPCH。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Apple to invest $30 billion in US chip manufacturing: https://www.foxbusiness.com/media/apple-invest-30-billion-us-chip-manufacturing
items.summary_cn: Apple宣布在美国追加300亿美元芯片制造投资，强化本土半导体制造主题，间接利好SK海力士等存储/AI供应链。

items.author: Trump
items.text: GREAT NEWS! Micron, one of the “HOTTEST” Companies in the World, just announced a MASSIVE 10 BILLION DOLLAR Investment in new Research Labs right here in America. They are keeping us at the absolute forefront of A.I. and Advanced Computing! 🇺🇸   Combined with their previous TREMENDOUS 250 BILLION DOLLAR commitment, they are creating over tens of thousands of Great American Jobs. We are bringing Critical Technologies BACK to the U.S.A. items.summary_cn: Trump发文盛赞Micron在美国本土追加100亿美元(累计2500亿美元)投资AI研发实验室，利好半导体/AI板块，SK海力士属同链条间接受益。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk’s SpaceX to expand beyond Texas Starbase with new Louisiana spaceport dedicated to Starship
items.summary_cn: SpaceX计划在德州Starbase之外扩建Louisiana新太空港，专用于Starship，扩张信号利好kcn的SPCX/SPCH。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk and Morgan Stanley’s SpaceX Predictions Are 7 Years Apart
items.summary_cn: Musk与Morgan Stanley对SpaceX估值/发射预测时间表差异巨大(差7年)，市场关注SpaceX成长路径，间接利好kcn持仓SPCX/SPCH。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk Is Expanding Tesla's Robotaxi Network Beyond Austin and Miami. Here's Why That's Important for the Future Success of the Stock.
items.summary_cn: Tesla Robotaxi网络将从Austin和Miami扩张，Musk力推Robotaxi业务进展，正面信号。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Trump Unleashes Scott Bessent on Iran: https://www.wsj.com/opinion/donald-trump-scott-bessent-sanctions-iran-oil-economy-96362772
items.summary_cn: Trump派财长Bessent主导对伊朗经济绞杀(制裁石油等生命线)，宏观层面影响原油与避险资产，无直接持仓关联。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk's xAI Sued For Using Child Survivor Photos To Generate Abusive Content
items.summary_cn: xAI因被指控用未成年幸存者照片生成虐待内容遭起诉，AI伦理与监管风险信号，可能拖累整个AI板块情绪。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk's SpacexAI faces another lawsuit from child sexual abuse survivor
items.summary_cn: xAI再因儿童性虐内容相关诉讼被起诉，与条目15同主题，重复报道合并弱化。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk: The 100 Most Influential People in AI 2026
items.summary_cn: Musk入选《TIME》2026 AI领域最具影响力100人，象征性荣誉，无直接市场含义。
